To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we developed an agent based on reinforcement learning that is capable of performing as well as a professional human games player across 49 Atari 2600 video games, 2) the agent was trained from scratch using only the raw pixel data and the game scores, and 3) we developed a novel method for learning the Q function that is based on a deep neural network and a novel experience replay system.

1) We have developed a novel artificial agent based on reinforcement learning, that is capable of solving a wide range of complex tasks directly from high dimensional visual inputs; 2) This agent is able to learn to perform a wide range of tasks directly from pixels, without the need for human crafted low dimensional features, and without the need for task specific architectures or hyperparameters.

1) deep neural networks trained using reinforcement learning are able to learn control policies directly from high-dimensional sensory input using end to end learning, and 2) these agents are able to successfully apply these policies in a wide variety of complex tasks.

the problem of how to develop artificial agents capable of autonomously learning to control a complex, dynamic world.
understanding and developing artificial intelligence that is capable of human level learning and control, with a particular focus on reinforcement learning.
the problem of developing artificial intelligence systems that are capable of learning to perform a diverse range of tasks.

the combination of deep learning and reinforcement learning is capable of achieving performance that rivals humans in a wide variety of challenging domains.
